result.reasoning: The blame trace shows the `runningBatchKey` field in `BddRunContext.java` was declared as `Optional<String>` without any default initialization from the very "Init project" commit that first added this file to the repository. This commit introduced the class with the uninitialized field, which later caused an NPE when `getRunningBatchKey()` was called before any batch was explicitly set (e.g., when running via jbehave-junit-runner, which doesn't call `putRunningBatch()`). The fix simply adds a default value `Optional.of("batch-1")` to this same field, directly addressing the omission introduced in this commit. No intermediate commit altered this logic except a copyright year bump, which is non-semantic.
